footnote_text: Represents a grant of 42,000 restricted stock units ("RSUs") pursuant to the Issuer's 2020 Equity Incentive Plan, as amended. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's common stock upon settlement. The RSUs vest over the one-year period following October 8, 2026, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service through the applicable vesting dates. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the RSUs will become fully vested upon the closing of the Issuer's proposed merger with North Immunology, Inc.
